content: <thought>To determine the number of carbonyl groups, the IR spectrum is most direct because carbonyl (C=O) groups give a characteristic strong absorption near 1700 cm⁻¹. I will obtain the IR spectrum for the sample and look for such peaks. If a carbonyl stretch is present, each distinct carbonyl typically gives one strong peak, so counting those peaks will give the number of carbonyl groups. If no carbonyl stretch is observed, the answer is 0.
